_notes: Generated by tools/make-sprites.mjs from data/outlines/ford-v3000s.json. All sprites share one cell and one origin (the front of the truck on the ground): draw them at the same place. ford-v3000s.png is the open truck, -tarp.png and -closed.png the same with a tarp or a box body (the cover setting), -tarpcloth.png has clothFrames frames of the tarp alone flapping loose, -tarpdown.png is the tarp lying crumpled. Points in pixels from the cell top left (y down); pixelsPerMetre = 10 (0.1 m pixels); ground = the row of the tyres' bottom. passengers: where the head of each seated man is (hidden when the cover is tarp or closed). exit: where infantry get off a tarp or closed truck. lights: the headlamps (pixel centre and radius; the game lights them on night maps, the beam points forward).
